name: Hisense E5Q Pro
summary: Hisense E5Q Pro ships with ads, telemetry and push messages. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This China-market Hisense E5Q Pro runs VIDAA on Android 11. It ships with Hisense advertising, telemetry, push messages, store, hotel and demo modes, preloaded content and gimmicks, a first-run setup and a screensaver of ambient photos. The list has 18 apps.

It was applied and used for a few days with no crashes and a normal boot. The inputs, HDMI-CEC and the Sogou keyboard kept working. The VIDAA home screen is left alone. TidyTV turns the rest off over Wi-Fi with a backup first and deletes nothing. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The VIDAA home screen and the tuner app
notes: There is an optional setting that blocks ads, which the list's header mentions as a bonus. It is not an app.

faq.q: Will the VIDAA home screen change?
faq.a: No. This list keeps the stock home screen and only removes the ad, telemetry, push and preloaded layer on top of it.
Yes. The update services are kept on purpose.

faq.q: Do HDMI and HDMI-CEC still work?
faq.a: Yes. They kept working after a few days of use.
